brief:
Gaza observers say current ground conditions and official statements may not reflect undisclosed Israeli military preparations ahead of scheduled elections, Shehab Wire reported. The conflict has repeatedly demonstrated that public messaging, leaked information, and even relative calm can mask behind-the-scenes planning, analysts noted.

The uncertainty reflects broader concerns about potential escalation timing tied to Israel's electoral calendar and the unpredictable nature of the ongoing conflict.

title: Israel may plan military operation before elections, analysts warn
